description: Implementation of the PhotoLibraryService class, which interfaces with the iOS Photos framework to fetch, process, and encode images from the user's photo library. It includes methods for requesting authorization, fetching latest photos with constraints, and processing images into base64-encoded JPEGs under size budgets.

classes.name: PhotoLibraryService
classes.description: A service class responsible for fetching and processing photos from the iOS device's photo library, with constraints on data size for WebSocket transport.

methods.name: latest
methods.description: Fetches the latest photos from the photo library, respecting size and quality constraints, and returns them as encoded payloads.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Checks and returns the current authorization status for photo library access.

methods.name: renderAsset
methods.description: Generates an image payload from a PHAsset, resizing and encoding to JPEG while respecting size constraints.

methods.name: encodeJpegUnderBudget
methods.description: Encodes a UIImage into JPEG data with specified quality, adjusting quality or size to stay under a maximum base64 size.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes a UIImage to a specified target width while maintaining aspect ratio.
